reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for structured cross-session memory, including SQLite persistence, relevance retrieval, context injection, memory tools, and scheduled consolidation with related session UI indicators.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 SQLite 的结构化跨会话记忆、检索、上下文注入和自动整理功能。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with structured cross-session memory stored in SQLite, including retrieval, context injection, memory tools, and automated consolidation.

capabilities: Persists structured cross-session memory in a workspace SQLite database
Injects stored memory into system and user message context
Provides tools to create, search, read, update, deduplicate, and consolidate memories
Runs scheduled or manually triggered memory consolidation during idle night windows
Maintains session records and exposes dream status through an SSE endpoint
Modifies client-side session display to show memory-related status indicators
